text:
maria: Quick weekly deep-dive for Polaris reserved GPU usage — headline: 7d GPU hours +38% (2,400 -> 3,312), avg queue depth 12 -> 29, p95 latency +12% (220ms -> 246ms), error rate ~0.9% (mostly OOM on rtx-x model). :eyes:
capacity-bot: automated summary: peak window Tue 13:00-15:30 UTC, reserved-pool-2 saturation 94% at 13:14 UTC, average burst rejects 18/min. link: https://dash.internal/redwood/polaris/usage
maria: quick query I ran (Prometheus):
```
sum by(pool) (increase(gpu_hours_total{tenant="polaris"}[7d]))
# reserved-pool-2: 680h incremental (72% of delta)
```
kevin: can you split by model variant and op type? suspect a small set of heavy rerank jobs.
maria: split shows 58% of extra hours from single model variant rtx-x-rerank, and 30% of queue spikes are batched rerank jobs scheduled by polaris-ingest.
ashley: FYI Polaris onboarding ramp started last Wed, they enabled parallel rerank jobs to speed up indexing. probably correlated.
kevin: recommend short fixes: 1) provision +1 GPU to reserved-pool-2 for 13:00-15:30 UTC for next 3 business days, 2) enable prewarm 30s for rtx-x-rerank, 3) add soft concurrency cap per tenant job. cost delta estimate ~+$120/day.
maria: agree. also flag as potential renewal-risk signal if we don't stabilize — discussed with AE, puts churn delta ~10% if cost spikes continue.
oliver: I'll handle provisioning. provisioning ticket created: infra#4521. ETA 2h. will post when ready.
ashley: can we throttle batched rerank during peak automatically? maybe add routing rule to fallback to quantized model when queue depth > 20.
kevin: yes we can add fallback policy for polaris -> rtx-x-quant at depth threshold 20; that should cut queue depth by ~40% per sim.
maria: assigning actions: @oliver provision +1 GPU (infra#4521), @kevin create routing fallback + prewarm config, @ashley coordinate with Polaris PM to reduce parallelism during peak. I'll update account health playbook and tag as "at-risk" until next check.
oliver: noted, will ping in #eng-infra when done.
maria: thanks — will reconvene next Wed same time to verify metrics. attaching perf snapshot and cost delta sim: https://dash.internal/redwood/polaris/weekly-plot :thumbsup:
